haikus.haiku:
Peanut butter sighs
Soft spread on toast, warm bright crumbs
Soft joy melts like jam
Happy #NationalFluffernutterDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Red flags flutter high
Kids laugh, ribbons kiss the air
Sun paints the streets gold
Happy #AmericanTagDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Eddie flies bright sky
Wings beat like drum of joy soft
Stars salute his name
#HappyBirthdayEddieRickenbacker from @ClamBakeSanta
